name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  windows-launcher:
    name: Windows launcher
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      LIVE: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        id: node
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install
        id: install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build
        id: build
        run: pnpm build
      # Native evidence (#496): a fresh, non-hidden folder directly below the runner temp,
      # outside the checkout and every fixture. The suite writes typed records only. Prepared
      # after the build, so its failure can never skip install, build or the native command; it
      # needs only the checkout and Node, so a failed install or build is still recorded.
      - name: Prepare native evidence
        id: evidence
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.node.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GG_TEST_EVIDENCE_EVENT_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          GG_TEST_EVIDENCE_EVENT_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: node tooling/scripts/windows-launcher-evidence.mjs init
      - name: Native Windows launcher acceptance
        id: native
        # Runs after a successful build whatever evidence preparation did. A preparation failure
        # still fails the job, and the suite then receives no evidence folder.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.build.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GG_TEST_WINDOWS_LAUNCHER_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ steps.evidence.outcome == 'success' && steps.evidence.outputs.dir || '' }}
        run: pnpm test:windows-launcher
      - name: Finalize native evidence
        id: finalize
        # Only a successfully prepared folder is finalized, and only finalized files are uploaded.
        if: ${{ always() && steps.evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GG_TEST_WINDOWS_LAUNCHER_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ steps.evidence.outputs.dir }}
          GG_TEST_WINDOWS_LAUNCHER_EVIDENCE_ID: ${{ steps.evidence.outputs.id }}
          GG_TEST_EVIDENCE_INSTALL_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.install.outcome }}
          GG_TEST_EVIDENCE_BUILD_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
          GG_TEST_EVIDENCE_NATIVE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.native.outcome }}
        run: node tooling/scripts/windows-launcher-evidence.mjs finalize
      - name: Upload native evidence
        if: ${{ always() && steps.finalize.outputs.paths != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-launcher-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ steps.finalize.outputs.paths }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: false
  repository-checks:
    name: Repository checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install (frozen lockfile)
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Reset acceptance
        run: pnpm test:reset

      - name: Recovery process acceptance
        run: pnpm test:recovery-process

      - name: Chat restart acceptance
        run: pnpm test:chat-restart

      - name: Wait restart acceptance
        run: pnpm test:wait-restart

      - name: Prompt restart acceptance
        run: pnpm test:prompt-restart
      - name: Webhook retry acceptance
        run: pnpm test:webhook-retry

      - name: Current-format migration acceptance
        run: pnpm test:upgrade

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Format check
        run: pnpm format:check

      - name: Layer rules
        run: pnpm check:layers

      - name: Migration generation is a no-op
        run: pnpm check:migrations

      - name: Design token rules
        run: pnpm check:tokens

      - name: Dependency graph rules
        run: pnpm check:deps

      - name: Shipped templates and deliberate-invalid refusal
        run: pnpm check:templates

      - name: Licence allowlist
        run: pnpm check:licenses

      - name: Generated docs are current
        run: pnpm check:docs

      - name: Design token contrast table is current and passing
        run: pnpm check:contrast

      - name: Dependency audit
        run: pnpm audit --audit-level=high

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install (frozen lockfile)
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # The same full build as Repository checks, so every suite sees the original built inputs.
      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Install Chromium for tooling browser measurements
        run: pnpm --filter @graphgoblin/web exec playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Unit tests with coverage thresholds
        id: coverage
        # The step cap leaves job time to retain the reports of a failed or timed-out run.
        timeout-minutes: 25
        # Each Vitest package owns its worker pool; avoid multiplying pools on the CI host.
        run: pnpm exec turbo run test:coverage --concurrency=1

      - name: Upload coverage reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: |
            packages/*/coverage/coverage-summary.json
            apps/*/coverage/coverage-summary.json
            tooling/coverage/coverage-summary.json
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Coverage report status
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          COVERAGE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.coverage.outcome }}
        run: |
          reports=$( (ls packages/*/coverage/coverage-summary.json apps/*/coverage/coverage-summary.json tooling/coverage/coverage-summary.json 2>/dev/null || true) | wc -l)
          {
            echo '## Coverage'
            echo
            echo "Coverage step: \`${COVERAGE_OUTCOME:-not run}\`. Package summaries retained: ${reports}."
            if [ "${COVERAGE_OUTCOME:-}" != success ]; then
              echo
              echo 'The coverage step did not succeed: any retained summaries are partial and establish no passing gate.'
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Coverage step: ${COVERAGE_OUTCOME:-not run}; package summaries retained: ${reports}"

  # The stable `Gates` status context. It always runs, even when a lane fails, is skipped or is
  # cancelled, and passes only when both lanes succeeded. It is never skippable, because a skipped
  # job would satisfy a branch rule that requires it.
  gates:
    name: Gates
    needs: [repository-checks, coverage]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Require Repository checks and Coverage to succeed
        shell: bash
        env:
          REPOSITORY_CHECKS: ${{ needs.repository-checks.result }}
          COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage.result }}
        run: |
          {
            echo '## Gates'
            echo
            echo '| Required job | Result |'
            echo '| --- | --- |'
            echo "| Repository checks | \`${REPOSITORY_CHECKS:-missing}\` |"
            echo "| Coverage | \`${COVERAGE:-missing}\` |"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Repository checks: ${REPOSITORY_CHECKS:-missing}; Coverage: ${COVERAGE:-missing}"
          if [ "${REPOSITORY_CHECKS:-}" = success ] && [ "${COVERAGE:-}" = success ]; then
            echo 'Gates passed: Repository checks and Coverage both succeeded.'
            exit 0
          fi
          echo '::error title=Gates::Repository checks and Coverage must both succeed; a failed, cancelled or skipped job never passes Gates.'
          exit 1

  browser:
    name: Browser
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    env:
      # Match Windows development and the existing Linux routing-performance job.
      GG_E2E_BROWSER_CHANNEL: msedge
      # Live checks spend subscription quota and require an installed, signed-in CLI.
      LIVE: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # issue-170-qa reads frozen golden definitions from an earlier commit with git ls-tree.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install (frozen lockfile)
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Edge
        run: pnpm --filter @graphgoblin/web exec playwright install --with-deps msedge

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Functional browser suite (no retries)
        timeout-minutes: 60
        working-directory: apps/web
        run: pnpm exec playwright test --retries=0 --workers=1

      - name: Browser coverage and exclusions
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" <<'SUMMARY'
          ## Functional browser gate

          Selected coverage: all `apps/web/e2e/**/*.spec.ts` against the built app on Edge with zero retries and one worker.
          This includes `script-recovery.spec.ts`: an isolated built API, kill/restart uncertainty, explicit retry consent, and resumed-run observation.
          The test step and report record the executed result, including any setup failure.
          The real API uses disposable storage and scripted harness/classifier boundaries; no paid provider is called.

          Skipped: `live.spec.ts` / `LIVE: build, publish, and run an inference loop against Codex from the UI`.
          It requires `LIVE=1`, an installed Codex CLI and a provider login, and spends subscription quota. CI sets `LIVE=0`.
          No other functional spec or test is skipped or gated on a provider login or installed CLI.

          Optional modes are off: `GG_FORMS_QA_PHASE` (historical before/after captures),
          `GG_ROUTING_SCREENSHOTS` (captures), `GG_ROUTING_PROFILE` (profiling), and
          `GG_ROUTING_STRICT_PERF` (stricter manual performance bounds). Their ordinary tests still run.
          `screens.capture.ts` is a manual screenshot utility, outside the `*.spec.ts` suite.
          Live/paid checks remain separate, manually authorized checks; this job schedules none.
          SUMMARY

      - name: Upload browser failure evidence
        if: failure() || cancelled()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: browser-failure
          path: |
            apps/web/test-results/
            apps/web/playwright-report/
          if-no-files-found: warn

  template-image:
    name: Template image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build the distributed image
        id: image
        run: docker build --tag graphgoblin-template-check .

      - name: Load installed templates without network or writable storage
        run: |
          docker run --rm -i --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --entrypoint node graphgoblin-template-check --input-type=module <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { existsSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { TemplateCatalog } from '/app/apps/api/dist/templates/catalog.js';
          const catalog = new TemplateCatalog('/app/apps/api/dist/catalog');
          const entries = await catalog.list();
          assert.deepEqual(entries.map(({ manifest }) => manifest.id).sort(),
            ['implementation', 'qa', 'review', 'starter']);
          const assetFiles = (root) => readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) =>
            entry.isDirectory() ? assetFiles(`${root}/${entry.name}`).map((file) => `${entry.name}/${file}`)
              : [entry.name]).sort();
          const keptFiles = ['catalog.json', ...entries.flatMap(({ manifest }) =>
            [`${manifest.id}/manifest.json`, `${manifest.id}/draft.json`])].sort();
          for (const root of ['/app/apps/api/templates', '/app/apps/api/dist/catalog']) {
            assert.deepEqual(assetFiles(root), keptFiles,
              'Only the index, manifests and independent drafts may ship; no configured graphs or support assets');
          }
          const supportDir = '/app/apps/api/dist/templates/github';
          assert.deepEqual(existsSync(supportDir) ? readdirSync(supportDir, { recursive: true }) : [], []);
          for (const name of ['runtime', 'binding', 'scripts', 'authority', 'prerequisites',
            'subjects', 'failures', 'support-result', 'instances']) {
            assert.equal(existsSync(`/app/apps/api/dist/templates/${name}.js`), false);
          }
          for (const { manifest, draft } of entries) {
            assert.ok(draft.nodes.length > 0);
            const first = await catalog.draft(manifest.id);
            const second = await catalog.draft(manifest.id);
            assert.deepEqual(first, draft);
            assert.notEqual(first, second);
            first.nodes[0].label = 'Changed copy';
            assert.deepEqual(second, draft);
            assert.deepEqual(await catalog.draft(manifest.id), draft);
            console.log(JSON.stringify({ template: manifest.id, version: manifest.version,
              draftNodes: draft.nodes.length }));
          }
          JS

      # Expression evaluation needs patches/jsonata@2.2.2.patch (docs/research/licenses.md). Check
      # the image's own installed copy through the compiled @graphgoblin/domain entry the API
      # resolves, never source or host node_modules. Every expression is finite. The restrictive
      # limits refuse at the first evaluator entry; without the patch the symbol-keyed hooks are
      # never bound, so those probes would succeed and fail their assertions instead of hanging.
      - name: Evaluate expressions with the installed JSONata patch
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.image.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          docker run --rm -i --network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --workdir /app/apps/api --entrypoint node graphgoblin-template-check --input-type=module <<'JS'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { ExpressionError, observeExpression } from '@graphgoblin/domain';
          const ordinary = await observeExpression('a + b', { a: 1, b: 2 });
          assert.deepEqual(ordinary, { ok: true, value: 3 });
          // Wider than the default depth of 200: accepted only when siblings are evaluated in turn.
          const width = Array.from({ length: 250 }, (_, n) => n);
          const wide = JSON.stringify({ array: width,
            object: Object.fromEntries(width.map((n) => [`k${n}`, n])) });
          const siblings = await observeExpression(wide, {});
          assert.ok(siblings.ok, `wide literal refused (${siblings.reason}): ${siblings.error?.message}`);
          assert.equal(JSON.stringify(siblings.value), wide);
          const refused = async (options, reason, message) => {
            const result = await observeExpression('1', {}, options);
            assert.equal(result.ok, false, `${reason} probe was not refused`);
            assert.equal(result.reason, reason);
            assert.ok(result.error instanceof ExpressionError);
            assert.equal(result.error.message, message);
            return { reason, message };
          };
          const depth = await refused({ maxDepth: 0 }, 'depth', 'expression exceeded max depth 0');
          const time = await refused({ timeoutMs: -1 }, 'time', 'expression exceeded -1ms');
          // The same cached source at the default limits: neither refusal may carry over.
          const fresh = await observeExpression('1', {});
          assert.deepEqual(fresh, { ok: true, value: 1 });
          console.log(JSON.stringify({ check: 'installed-jsonata-patch', ordinary: ordinary.value,
            wideSiblings: width.length, depth, time, fresh: fresh.value }));
          JS
